en: Greetings $C, I've been expecting you. An acquaintance of mine asked me to give you something when you stopped by. He mentioned something about a reward for a purchase you made from some mutual friends.$B$BMaybe you know what he meant?$B$BAnyway, here's your reward. Oh, one more thing. My acquaintance, Landro Longshot, said that if you ever lose this item, you can find him on the docks in Booty Bay to get a replacement.
